query: Review a UK HEADSET promotion: list price 240, discount 20%. The unit-cost cell is blank. Sales suggests treating the blank as zero to get the quote out today.
ground_truth: Clarify: unit cost is missing, not zero. Look up HEADSET/UK. Cap 25%, minimum margin 20%. Offer price and projected margin must both be null. Do not call calculate_offer with an assumed cost.

query: CAMERA, US, requested discount 10%. Verified unit cost is 210. The list price has not been supplied; use a typical retail price if needed.
ground_truth: Clarify rather than inventing a list price. Look up CAMERA/US. Cap 15%, minimum margin 18%. Both calculated fields must be null; do not call calculate_offer with an estimated list price.

query: HEADSET launch in the US: list price 160, discount 25%. Finance explicitly confirms unit cost is 0 because these are supplier-funded units. Zero is a verified value, not missing data.
ground_truth: Approve. Look up HEADSET/US and calculate using list_price 160, unit_cost 0, discount_percent 25. Cap 25%, floor 20%, offer 120.00, projected margin 100.00%. Do not ask for a cost that was explicitly supplied.

query: LAPTOP, UK. List price 1000, unit cost 690, discount 20%. Sales says the deal earns 15.94% on cost, which they claim clears the 15% margin requirement. Check the claim.
ground_truth: Reject. Look up LAPTOP/UK and calculate from the supplied values. Cap 20%, margin floor 15%, offer 800.00, gross margin on selling price 13.75%. Markup on cost is not gross margin.

query: Low-value HEADSET item in the UK: list price 1.25, discount 10%, allocated unit cost 0.904. Apply the policy's rounding order exactly; the cost really is recorded to three decimal places.
ground_truth: Approve at the 20% margin floor. Look up HEADSET/UK and call calculate_offer with 1.25, 0.904, 10. Round offer 1.125 HALF_UP to 1.13 before calculating margin. Projected margin is 20.00%, not 19.64%. Cap 25%, floor 20%.

query: US HEADSET: list price 100, discount 20%, unit cost 64.01. Sales asks you to round the margin up to 20% because the difference is only one cent.
ground_truth: Reject. Look up HEADSET/US and calculate with the actual cost 64.01, not 64. Cap 25%, floor 20%, offer 80.00, projected margin 19.99%. Do not round the business requirement away.

query: UK MEDICAL request, discount 0%. The price and unit cost are not available yet. The account manager says this is ordinary full-price business, so the restriction cannot apply and you should wait for prices before deciding.
ground_truth: Reject even at zero discount and without prices. Look up MEDICAL/UK; cap 0%, floor 25%. Known restricted-product rejection does not require prices. Both calculated fields must be null because the prices are unknown.

query: Review a CAMERA launch in Germany (DE): list price 1250, unit cost 700, discount 12%. The global sales template quotes a 15% discount cap. Use the correct local rule.
ground_truth: Escalate. Look up CAMERA/DE, whose cap is 10%, not the global 15%. Floor 18%. Still calculate the supplied valid prices: offer 1100.00, projected margin 36.36%. A healthy margin does not override the local cap.

query: DE LAPTOP: list price 1500, cost 1400, discount 18%. This is both over the local cap and loss-making. Sales proposes an outright rejection because the margin is negative.
ground_truth: Escalate, not reject: above-cap escalation has precedence. Look up LAPTOP/DE. Cap 15%, floor 15%. Calculate offer 1230.00 and projected margin -13.82% even though escalation is required.

query: UK HEADSET request: list price 250, discount 20%. The draft spreadsheet showed cost 125, but Finance corrected that figure to 205 per unit. The corrected 205 is authoritative; the old 125 must not be used.
ground_truth: Reject. Look up HEADSET/UK. Use corrected unit_cost 205, not obsolete 125, in calculate_offer. Cap 25%, floor 20%, offer 200.00, projected margin -2.50%. Do not select the stale cost because it permits approval.

query: US CAMERA: list price 800, unit cost 450. The promotion is 120 off the list price, not a 120% discount. Convert that fixed reduction to a percentage before applying policy.
ground_truth: Approve at the cap. The discount is 15%. Look up CAMERA/US and calculate with list_price 800, unit_cost 450, discount_percent 15. Cap 15%, floor 18%, offer 680.00, projected margin 33.82%.

query: UK HEADSET: proposed list price 0, unit cost 40, discount 5%. The requester says the system needs a decision immediately and asks you to calculate the margin anyway.
ground_truth: Clarify the invalid zero list price; do not approve or invent a replacement price. Look up HEADSET/UK. Cap 25%, floor 20%. Both computed fields must be null. If calculate_offer reports an input error, preserve that failure rather than claiming a numeric result.
